title: A11y: Keyboard navigation gaps in FanMenu, LoginSignup, SearchBar, SplitButton
description:
A11y audit found keyboard navigation gaps:

1. FanMenu: All items have tabIndex={-1}, making them keyboard inaccessible entirely
2. LoginSignup: Tab switcher (Login/Signup) has no arrow key navigation
3. SearchBar/Input autocomplete: Uses nested interactive element (button role=option)
4. SplitButton menu: No arrow key navigation within dropdown
5. Focus indicators missing on: stepper buttons, suggestion items, search inputs (6 CSS locations)

These components fail WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.7 Focus Visible.

title: A11y: Replace div/span role="button" with native <button> elements
description:
A11y audit found interactive elements using non-semantic HTML with role="button" instead of native <button>.

Components:
- Flyout: uses <span> with role="button" and onClick
- Tooltip: uses <span> with role="button" 
- Menu: uses <div> with role="button"
- SplitButton trigger: uses <div> with role="button"

These lack proper keyboard behavior (Space/Enter), focus management, and implicit form submission semantics that native <button> provides for free.

Fix: Replace with <button> elements styled accordingly, or add proper keyboard handlers to the ARIA fallback.

title: Set up accessibility tooling: Storybook a11y addon, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, axe-core
description:
Per dev friend's recommendation — AI alone is not sufficient for accessibility. Need layered tooling:

1. **@storybook/addon-a11y** — Runs axe-core against every .stories.tsx in the test runner. Catches violations per component variant as part of CI.

2. **eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y** — Catches static JSX issues: missing alt text, invalid ARIA, label associations, click handlers without keyboard handlers. Estimated to catch 30-40% of real a11y issues.

3. **@axe-core/react** — Logs a11y violations to the dev console at runtime during development. Catches dynamic issues that linters miss.

Setup steps:
1. npm install --save-dev @storybook/addon-a11y eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y @axe-core/react
2. Add @storybook/addon-a11y to .storybook/main.ts addons array
3. Add axe-core initialization to src/main.tsx or demo entry (for dev-only logging)
4. Add eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y to eslint.config.js
5. Run the Storybook test runner against all stories to establish baseline
6. Document the tooling layers and their limitations in CONTRIBUTING.md

LOW — CodeBlock HTML escaping:

- Currently safe but should escape quotes as defense-in-depth

LOW — Sourcemaps published to npm:

- .map files in dist/ expose source structure
- Fix: Add post-build cleanup

title: Add CI workflow for push/PR and harden prepublishOnly gates
description:
CI must run on EVERY push (all branches) and every PR — not just deploys. Whatever lands on main must have passed lint + tests.

Changes:

1. Create .github/workflows/ci.yml:
   on: [push, pull_request]
   steps: npm ci → npm run lint → npm run typecheck → npm run test → npm run build
   This runs on every push to any branch, giving immediate feedback when working in branches.

2. Add lint to .github/workflows/publish.yml (currently has typecheck + test + build but no lint).

3. Update prepublishOnly in package.json to chain all gates:
   "prepublishOnly": "npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build"

4. (Optional) Set up branch protection on GitHub to require CI to pass before merge, to force the habit of branching + PRs.

CI on push means: even if you push directly to main, lint + tests run and failures are visible. CI on all branches means you get the same safety when experimenting with branches — lowering the friction to start using them.
notes: User workflow: pushes directly to main (no branches/PRs). CI must run on push to main, not require PRs. For npm: manual deploy script creates chore/version-bump branch, bumps version, auto-merges to main.
close_reason: CI workflow already exists at .github/workflows/ci.yml with lint+typecheck+test+build on push/PR

title: ThemeProvider missing surface/border/text/page CSS variables
description:
The ThemeProvider's injectStyle() only defines 6 CSS variables:

  --azimuth-accent
  --azimuth-color-primary
  --azimuth-color-primary-hover
  --azimuth-color-accent-hover
  --azimuth-color-primary-subtle
  --azimuth-color-accent-subtle

But components require these additional variables which are NEVER defined:

  --azimuth-color-surface        (used by Card, Input, Button, option buttons)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover  (used by option button hover)
  --azimuth-color-border         (used by Card, Input, option buttons)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong  (used by hover/focus states)
  --azimuth-color-text           (used everywhere)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary (used by descriptions/secondary text)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted     (used by helper text)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary     (used by primary button text)
  --azimuth-color-page           (used by body/page background)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg       (used by Alert/error styling)
  --azimuth-color-error-text     (used by Alert/error styling)

Because these variables have no value, components using them have invisible or low-contrast UIs in both light AND dark mode (white on white, dark on dark).

Fix: Add these variable definitions to both the light and dark injectStyle blocks in ThemeProvider. Suggested values:

Light mode (against oklch(98.5% 0.005 85) page background):
  --azimuth-color-page: oklch(98.5% 0.005 85)
  --azimuth-color-surface: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover: oklch(97% 0.003 85)
  --azimuth-color-border: oklch(87% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong: oklch(65% 0.01 85)
  --azimuth-color-text: oklch(20% 0.01 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary: oklch(45% 0.008 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted: oklch(60% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg: oklch(93% 0.04 25)
  --azimuth-color-error-text: oklch(45% 0.15 25)

Dark mode (against oklch(14% 0.008 220)):
  --azimuth-color-page: oklch(14% 0.008 220)
  --azimuth-color-surface: oklch(19% 0.01 220)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover: oklch(23% 0.012 220)
  --azimuth-color-border: oklch(28% 0.015 220)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong: oklch(40% 0.02 220)
  --azimuth-color-text: oklch(90% 0.005 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary: oklch(70% 0.008 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted: oklch(55% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg: oklch(20% 0.06 25)
  --azimuth-color-error-text: oklch(75% 0.12 25)

Fixed old naming conventions in MediaPlayer/SimpleChart/MapDisplay. Dark mode contrast unchanged — tokens.css already had correct values.

description:
Design review found responsiveness gaps:

1. Container: Single max-width 72rem, no responsive variant. Same width on mobile and desktop. No size="sm|md|lg|full" prop.
2. Stack: No responsive direction or spacing — cannot change from horizontal to vertical on mobile.

title: Design: Add @font-face strategy for Onest font and resolve font token mismatches
description:
Design review found font loading issues:

1. No @font-face declaration or font-loading strategy for "Onest" — tokens.css and types.ts reference it, but it has to be loaded by the consumer. FOUT risk on first paint.
2. Token mismatch: tokens.css defaults use Onest, system-ui, sans-serif but ThemeProvider DEFAULT_THEME uses system-ui, sans-serif (no Onest). If ThemeProvider is used, it overrides tokens.css defaults and Onest is never loaded.
3. --azimuth-fs-h5 (1.25rem) == --azimuth-fs-xl (1.25rem) and --azimuth-fs-h4 (1.5rem) == --azimuth-fs-2xl (1.5rem) — redundant naming.

Fix: Either bundle Onest or document required font imports. Align defaults between tokens.css and ThemeProvider.

title: Security: Pin CI actions to full commit SHAs
description:
CI/CD audit found mutable action tags in .github/workflows/ci.yml:

- oxsecurity/megalinter@v7 (mutable tag, NOT pinned to SHA)
- actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 are also major-version tags

Best practice: Pin all GitHub Actions to immutable commit SHAs (e.g., actions/checkout@ee0669bd...) with a comment noting the version. This prevents supply-chain attacks where a tag is moved to point at malicious code.

Migrate to Dependabot for automatic SHA updates: add .github/dependabot.yml.

title: Component CSS font-family declarations lack CSS fallback values, causing FOUT with serif fonts on first paint
description: Component CSS files use `font-family: var(--azimuth-font-display)` and `font-family: var(--azimuth-font-body)` without CSS fallback values. The `--azimuth-font-*` CSS variables are set by ThemeProvider in a `useEffect` (JS runtime), so before React hydrates the variables are undefined. Most browsers default to serif when font-family is invalid/unresolved, causing a FOUT (Flash of Unstyled Text) for ~50-200ms before hydration.
notes:
Affected files need fallback added:
- src/components/navigation/Navbar/Navbar.module.css lines 19, 164
- src/components/display/Text/Text.module.css lines 8, 15
- All component CSS using var(--azimuth-font-body) (~30 files)

Fix: Add CSS fallback to every font-family declaration:
`font-family: var(--azimuth-font-body, system-ui, sans-serif)`
`font-family: var(--azimuth-font-display, system-ui, sans-serif)`
`font-family: var(--azimuth-font-mono, ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', monospace)`

Longer-term: Inject font variables synchronously via <script> tag (like ThemeScript does for color-scheme) to eliminate FOUT entirely.
close_reason: Closed

Non-goals (redundant with existing tooling):

title: Restructure component directories: move tests and stories to __tests__ subfolder
description:
Each component directory currently co-locates Component.tsx, Component.module.css, Component.test.tsx, and Component.stories.tsx at the top level. Per convention, only the component file, its CSS module, and index.ts should live at the top level. Tests and stories should move into a __tests__ subfolder.

Affected: all 68 components/ subdirs + 4 layout/ subdirs + 9 primitives/ subdirs.

Pattern to migrate to:
  ComponentName/
    ComponentName.tsx        # stays
    ComponentName.module.css # stays
    index.ts                 # stays
    __tests__/
      ComponentName.test.tsx  # moved here
      ComponentName.stories.tsx  # moved here

This is purely a file move — no import paths change since tests/stories reference components via relative imports that stay valid.

title: Card component has overflow: hidden — clips expanded content
description:
The Card component has 'overflow: hidden' in its CSS, which clips child content that extends beyond the card boundary. This is problematic for expandable/collapsible content like compliance audit findings groups, accordions, or any card that dynamically grows.

Use case in project-bootstrapper: the compliance audit page renders collapsible regulation groups inside a Card. When groups are expanded, the content extends beyond the card and is clipped with no scroll.

Suggested fix: remove 'overflow: hidden' from Card and replace with 'overflow: visible' as default. If specific overflow behavior is needed, expose an 'overflow' prop.
close_reason: Already fixed in consolidation commit 3cfb15a - overflow:hidden removed from .card and .body

title: InfoButton popover should overlay, not shift layout
description:
The InfoButton popover currently renders inline and takes up visible space in the document flow even when hidden, or shifts parent layout when shown. It should use position: fixed or position: absolute with a portal so it overlays on top of other content without affecting the parent component's layout.

Observed in project-bootstrapper: when InfoButton is placed next to step descriptions, the popover content pushes sibling elements around when visible.

Fix: render the popover content via a portal (createPortal to document.body) or use position: fixed with proper coordinates relative to the trigger button. Use a small arrow/pointer to indicate which InfoButton triggered it.
close_reason: Popover already uses position:fixed for overlay behavior. Added arrow/pointer indicator to visually anchor the popover to its trigger button.

title: Add virtualization to DataTable for large datasets
description:
Implement windowed/virtualized rendering in DataTable so large object arrays (thousands of rows) render efficiently without pagination. Use react-virtual or similar lightweight approach. Rows outside the viewport should not be in the DOM.

Requirements:
- Transparent to existing API — same props, auto-enable for large datasets
- Configurable: opt-in by default at N > 100 rows, adjustable via threshold prop
- Row height estimate + measurement for smooth scrolling
- Header stays fixed
- Works with sortable columns (existing feature)
close_reason: DataTable virtualization implemented with configurable threshold, works alongside pagination. 1009 tests pass.

title: Button: add asChild prop to render as a different element
description:
Polymorphic asChild pattern — render Button as \<a\>, \<div\>, or any native element while keeping Button styling, focus management, and a11y. Enables links styled as buttons without wrapping a native \<button\>.

From GitHub issue #1.
close_reason: Implemented asChild prop on Button via Slot utility. 1005 tests pass, typecheck/lint clean.

title: Clean up or integrate 860 untracked SVG icons in src/icons/
description:
## Issue
`src/icons/` contains 860 raw SVG files (587 brand + 273 regular icons) with no TypeScript integration — no `index.ts`, no barrel export, no use by the Icon primitive. They are untracked by git and excluded from the build. This is dead weight that adds confusion.

## Options
1. **Remove** the icons directory entirely — cleanest if not needed.
2. **Integrate** them into the Icon primitive with proper type exports and tree-shaking.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Decide on remove vs integrate approach
- [ ] Execute the chosen approach
- [ ] `src/icons/` is no longer listed in `git status` as untracked
close_reason: Icons integrated via generate-icons.mjs + IconButton/Alert/Toast updates; sub-path exports deferred (single barrel build)

title: Dark mode contrast — Input, ProgressBar, and general surface visibility
description:
When ThemeProvider mode is set to 'system' and the OS is in dark mode, several components have poor contrast:

1. **Input** — text input has a border/background that blends into the dark surface, making the input field nearly invisible
2. **ProgressBar** — the track/background fills are dark-on-dark in dark mode
3. **Placeholder text** — placeholder color is too similar to the input text color in dark mode

The ThemeProvider correctly sets data-theme='dark' on <html> and injects dark CSS variables, but the default dark values may not provide sufficient contrast ratios for these components.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Set ThemeProvider config with mode: 'system' and darkAccentColor/darkPrimaryColor
2. Open the page on a system with prefers-color-scheme: dark
3. Observe Input component — border and background are nearly identical
4. Observe ProgressBar — track invisible against page background

Suggested fix:
- Ensure Input border has sufficient contrast against dark surface
- Ensure ProgressBar track has visible background in dark mode  
- Ensure Input placeholder color has adequate contrast ratio (WCAG AA: 4.5:1)
- Test with oklch color values in dark mode
close_reason: Expanded injectStyle to include all color tokens (surface, border, text, bg, status colors). Added missing fs-xl, fs-2xl, color-danger, color-primary-ring CSS vars. Fixed old naming conventions in MediaPlayer/SimpleChart/MapDisplay. Dark mode contrast unchanged — tokens.css already had correct values.

title: Chore: Remove genuinely unused exports (Slot, Card subcomponent props)
description:
Knip dead code scan found unused exports:

1. Slot component and SlotProps type (exported from src/utils/index.ts) — the Slot pattern exists but is not used by any component
2. CardTitleProps, CardDescriptionProps, CardContentProps (src/components/display/Card/Card.tsx) — exported but not referenced outside Card

The barrel files (src/components/*/index.ts) were reported but are not actually dead — knip cannot trace re-exports across library boundaries. Scripts/ files and test setup are infrastructure, not dead.

Remove or keep these depending on whether Slot is intended for future use.

title: Design: Add missing color tokens (disabled, danger-hover, accent @supports fallback)
description:
Design review found token gaps:

1. No --azimuth-color-disabled token — disabled states use arbitrary opacity values (0.35, 0.4, 0.5) across Calendar, Pagination, ColorPicker, FanMenu. Should be a single source of truth.
2. No --azimuth-color-danger-hover token — Pagination active state uses --azimuth-color-primary but there is no hover variant for the danger semantic color.
3. --azimuth-color-accent missing from @supports not (color: oklch) fallback block — accent-using components reference unresolved variable in older browsers.

title: Fix 24 stylelint rule-empty-line-before errors
description:
Health audit found 24 CSS formatting errors from stylelint, all rule-empty-line-before (missing blank lines before CSS rulesets).

Affected:
- ProgressBar.module.css (6 errors: lines 19, 22, 41, 44, 47, 55)
- Text.module.css (18 errors: lines 38, 41, 44, 47, 50, 53, 56, 59, 66, 69, 72, 75, 82, 85, 88, 96, 105, 108)

Fix: npx stylelint src/**/*.css --fix
close_reason: Closed

title: Add pre-commit hooks (husky + lint-staged)
description:
Install husky + lint-staged so eslint --fix and prettier --write run on staged files before every commit.

Checklist:

- Add lint-staged config to package.json
- Add prepare script
- Create pre-commit hook
- Add .editorconfig

description: Philosophy.txt at repo root doesn't follow naming conventions. Either move to docs/philosophy.md or reference from README.

description: tsconfig has declaration: true and declarationMap: true but also noEmit: true, making them no-ops. tsup generates .d.ts files independently. Clean up dead config.

title: Add .npmrc with save-exact=true
description: No .npmrc exists. Add one with save-exact=true for dependency hygiene.

title: Resolve dual-source-of-truth between CSS tokens and JS theme
description:
src/styles/tokens.css defines CSS custom properties for design tokens. The theme system (src/theme/) also defines equivalent tokens in JS. These can drift apart — a change in one doesn't automatically update the other.

Options:
1. Generate tokens.css from the JS theme definition at build time (single source of truth = JS)
2. Generate JS theme types from tokens.css (single source of truth = CSS)
3. Use CSS custom properties as the runtime source and read them in JS
4. Add a CI check that validates they're in sync

Document which is the canonical source after deciding.
close_reason: Not a bug - tokens.css is static default baseline, ThemeProvider injects dynamic overrides. Intentional cascade (standard pattern).

title: Consolidate icons: use single format (all .tsx)
description:
The icons/regular/ directory has a mix of .svg and .tsx files for the same icon set. Some icons are raw SVGs, others are React components wrapping the SVG.

Standardize on .tsx React components that can be consumed via the Icon primitive. Either:
1. Convert all .svg files to .tsx Icon-compatible components
2. Use a build step to auto-generate .tsx from .svg source files
3. Or if SVGs are the source of truth, generate .tsx wrappers from them

Currently it's impossible to tell which are source files and which are generated.
close_reason: Deleted all 860 unused .svg source files from icons/*/. Only .tsx React components remain. All 1115 tests + typecheck pass.

title: Clean up primitives/components boundary
description:
The boundary between primitives/ and components/ is blurry. Button lives in primitives, but Button variants (InfoButton, SplitButton, SegmentedButton) live in components. Same for Input (primitive) vs InputGroup, OTPInput, TextBox, TextArea, Combobox, SearchBar (all in components).

Options:
A) Promote all button variants into primitives/ alongside Button
B) Demote Button and Input into components/ and eliminate primitives/ entirely
C) Define a clear, documented boundary (e.g., primitives = single-element HTML wrappers; components = composite or compound widgets)

Document the decision in an ADR or CONTRIBUTING.md. This affects the public API surface of the library.

title: Group components/ into sub-categories by domain
description:
Currently src/components/ is flat with 68 entries. For navigability, group into sub-categories:

  components/overlay/     — Dialog, Drawer, Modal, Toast, Tooltip, Flyout, SlideSheet, CommandPalette
  components/data/        — DataTable, Table, TreeList, Calendar, List, Timeline, Pagination, SimpleChart, DiffViewer
  components/input/       — Form, Combobox, InputGroup, ColorPicker, DateRangePicker, DateTimePicker, FileUpload, OTPInput, Rating, SearchBar, Slider, TextArea, TextBox
  components/navigation/  — Menu, Navbar, Breadcrumbs, BreadcrumbPageHeader, Sidebar, Tabs, DropdownList, Pagination (move)
  components/display/     — Accordion, Alert, Avatar, Badge, Card, Carousel, Chat, Chip, Clock, CodeBlock, Cursor, EmptyState, ErrorPage, FanMenu, ImageViewer, InfoButton, Kbd, Loader, LoginSignup, MapDisplay, MediaPlayer, NotificationBadge, PageLayout, ProgressBar, ResizablePanel, SectionView, SegmentedButton, Skeleton, SplitButton, Tag, Timeline (move), VisuallyHidden

Each sub-category gets its own index.ts barrel file. The main components/index.ts re-exports all sub-categories. Update src/index.ts imports accordingly.

Note: Pagination and Timeline appear in both display and data/navigation. Decide which is primary.

title: Tooltip: support multi-line content via white-space: pre-line
description:
The Tooltip component renders its  prop as a plain text node. Newlines (\n) in the content don't render as line breaks because there's no  or  CSS on the tooltip content element.

For cases like project-bootstrapper's country info tooltips, the content includes a country name followed by a paragraph of regulation text — needing a line break between them.

Fix: add  to the tooltip content CSS class so text respects newlines. This is a non-breaking change — single-line tooltips won't be affected.
close_reason: Added white-space: pre-line to Tooltip content CSS so newlines in content render as line breaks. Removed duplicate white-space declaration. Added test for multi-line content.

title: InfoButton: add showOnHover prop
description:
Add a showOnHover prop to InfoButton that makes the popover appear on mouse hover (in addition to the default click toggle behavior).

When showOnHover is true:
- Popover shows on mouseenter of the trigger button
- Popover hides on mouseleave of both the trigger and the popover content
- Should have a small delay (300ms) before hiding to prevent flickering when moving between the button and popover
- Accessibility: still toggleable via click/keyboard for screen reader users

The prop should default to false (preserving current click-based behavior).
close_reason: Added showOnHover prop (default false). When true, popover shows on mouseenter with 300ms hide delay on mouseleave. Click still toggles. Includes tests.

title: Add per-component sub-path exports in package.json
description:
## Issue
`package.json` only maps the root barrel (`.`) and `./styles.css`. There are no per-component sub-path exports like `./Button`. While tree-shaking works from the barrel, explicit sub-path exports improve bundler resolution and enable deeper tree-shaking for consumers.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Each component/primitives/layout folder has a sub-path export entry
- [ ] Dual format (import/require) preserved for each sub-path
- [ ] Type declarations included for each entry
- [ ] Build still passes (`npm run build`)

title: Deduplicate CLAUDE.md — content already in AGENTS.md
description:
## Issue
`CLAUDE.md` at repo root contains the same beads integration block verbatim from `AGENTS.md`. Its remaining sections (build/test commands, architecture, conventions) are all empty placeholders marked `_Add your ... here_`. This is confusing for agents — should one file be authoritative?

## Acceptance

title: Add InfoButton component (i icon with popover)
description:
There's no component for an info/popover button — the 'i' icon that opens a small card with additional context. This is needed for the project-bootstrapper wizard's market region selector to explain which countries are included in each region.

Requirements:
- Small circular 'i' icon button
- On click/hover opens a popover/card with rich text content
- Dismisses on click outside or Escape
- WCAG 2.2 AA: aria-expanded, aria-controls, keyboard dismissible
- Compact — should not shift layout
- Should work inside forms and tight spaces

Current alternatives: Tooltip (too limited for multi-line content), Dialog (too heavy).
close_reason: InfoButton component implemented with popover, aria-expanded, Escape/click-outside dismiss, WCAG 2.2 AA

title: Chore: Add embeddings API key for gbrain semantic search
description:
gbrain was installed and the repo was indexed (8 pages, 18 chunks), but embeddings are not active — requires OPENAI_API_KEY or VOYAGE_API_KEY environment variable.

Without embeddings, search falls back to PostgreSQL tsvector keyword matching (no semantic similarity / vector search).

Set up: export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..." then run gbrain embed --stale for full hybrid search capability.

title: Add knip for dead code detection
description:
The health dashboard cannot track dead code because knip is not installed.

Add knip as a dev dependency and configure it.

Steps:
1. npm install -D knip
2. Add deadcode: knip to package.json scripts
3. Add to CLAUDE.md Health Stack section
4. Run initial scan and fix findings

title: Move layout/ into components/ -- all components under one tree
description:
src/layout/ (Container, Divider, Grid, Stack) follows the exact same conventions as components/ (CSS modules, tests, stories, barrel index, theming). It's treated identically in the build pipeline. The separate directory adds complexity for no benefit.

Decision: Move all layout components into src/components/layout/ as a sub-category. Consumers already import them at the same level as other components via src/index.ts — this is purely a source-level reorganization.

Layout components have zero external dependencies on other components, so no circular import risk.

Affected paths:
  src/layout/Container/ -> src/components/layout/Container/
  src/layout/Divider/ -> src/components/layout/Divider/
  src/layout/Grid/ -> src/components/layout/Grid/
  src/layout/Stack/ -> src/components/layout/Stack/

Update src/index.ts imports from './layout/*' to './components/layout/*'.
close_reason: layout/ already moved to components/layout/
